critical_findings: Mandatory SolutionWorkflow human holdout_gate is stronger than default runtime policy (optional approval false).
Ambiguous final failure/crash cannot be retried safely from stage status or holdout_uses alone; local counter persisted only after successful final record path.
Tabular lock is reproducible source/settings/seed and in-memory train/test indices; no dedicated durable row-membership fingerprint is written in normal data record (unlike several machine splits).
Task graph must not call prepare directly: it loads tables, constructs split, may run auxiliary role logic/recipe configuration; not a pure capability check.
Some mandatory family templates describe stricter guarantees than implemented evidence: near-copy isolation, person-stated budget, target transform, normal-shape timing.
SolutionWorkflow is descriptive/validated contract inside SolutionMap and evaluation; no generic executor traverses its steps.
WorkflowRun.build is a readback from existing stages: 12 conceptual steps must not become 12 tool calls.
Registry export_notebook only works for supported tabular exports; GET export/solution-report may invoke reporter and write cache, so do not preview it during planning under read-only assumption.
